note: Issue #63: Jeanne's first effects from PixelLab's /vfx (docs/design/2026-10-25-jeanne-effects.md). Pro artist with two variants of each effect, lite for the main ones as a cheap comparison; the taunt aura is generated around Ben's approved knight frame. A pro description of 400 characters or more is quoted 1.25x, so those are estimated at 8.

body.name: jeanne sun A
body.description: A bright sun-like explosion bursting outward from one point, shoving everything away: a blinding white-gold core flashes, a thick ring of orange-red flame races outward to the canvas edge with sparks, then embers drift and fade. Fills the whole 512 by 512 canvas, 16 frames at 20 fps, plays once, anchored at the centre. Pixel art for a 1080p beat 'em up with 230 px tall characters, lit from the top left, transparent background.
